title: Human Resource Executive
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Manage attendance, leaves, and other HR generalist activities.
 Coordinate with employees to resolve queries related to payroll processing.
 Ensure accurate data entry into the system for employee records.
 Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information regarding employee personal details.
 Provide support in recruitment process by coordinating interviews and onboarding new hires.

Key Skills: HR Generalist Activities,HR Coordination,Attendance Management,Resource,Hrsd,Generalist Activities,Management,Coordination
